From: Alice Johnson <alice@blueharbor.com>

Cc: security@blueharbor.com
Date: Fri, 12 Jul 2024 08:32:00 -0700
Subject: KMS/HSM evidence: transit ciphers, rotation sampling request

Hi Mina,

We are kicking off our SIG/SOC2 evidence pull for BlueHarbor's onboarding and have a couple of items we need from Redwood related to encryption and key management. Can you provide the following artifacts and a short timeline for delivery?

- Current in-transit cipher policy (TLS versions + cipher suite list) and proof of enforcement for control scope (prod endpoints only).
- Snapshot of recent key rotation events for tenant partitions (last 90 days) including rotation timestamps and operator IDs (redacted where required).
- HSM attestation or vendor-signed statement showing FIPS/Module details and the last attestation date.
- Recommended sampling plan for rotation evidence we can include in our SIG questionnaire (how many cycles, what logs to request).

If possible we'd like a draft bundle by end-of-week next Friday (2024-07-19). If there are items that require additional approvals, please flag them and give an estimate.

Thanks,
Alice Johnson
Sr. Security Engineer
BlueHarbor Financial

[Attachment: example_SIG_template.pdf (pdf)]

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Alice Johnson <alice@blueharbor.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jul 2024 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: KMS/HSM evidence: transit ciphers, rotation sampling request

Alice —

Thanks for the clear list. We'll scope this as: prod API endpoints + dedicated tenant stores. A few notes and asks from our side so we can target a complete bundle by 2024-07-19: 

1) Cipher list: we can export the active TLS policy and a short enforcement proof (config + sample curl TLS handshake). Delivery: 1 business day.

2) Rotation snapshots: we can provide an anonymized CSV of rotation events (timestamp, key-id hash, rotation-type, operator-id). We need to confirm with legal whether operator IDs can be pseudo-anonymized for audit copies; that will take 48 hours.

3) HSM attestation: vendor-signed attestation (or PEM) is available; we'll include the most recent vendor statement and the device serials. If you need HSM operator shift logs, call that out now.

4) Sampling plan: I'll propose a compact 3-cycle sampling plan that covers: initial rotation sample, intermediate (30 days), and a final snapshot. That will include which logs to request (rotation audit, keystore manifest, TLS handshake samples).

I'll loop in the engineering lead for the rotation manifest and a copy of the TLS cipher list.

Deliverables planned: rotation_manifest_v1.pdf (redacted), hsm_attestation_2024.pem, tls_cipher_list.txt, sampling_plan.docx (draft).

If BlueHarbor needs CAIQ-specific mapping, we can add a short table. 

Best,
Mina Haddad
Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Adding the initial artifacts here. See attached rotation_manifest_v1.pdf and tls_cipher_list.txt. Summary:

- rotation_manifest_v1.pdf: contains redacted rotation timestamps for tenant key families, rotation type (scheduled/auto/manual), and high-level operator role (e.g., keystore-ops) rather than individual names. We redacted operator IDs per privacy guidance.
- tls_cipher_list.txt: current TLS policy (TLS1.2+ preferred, TLS1.3 enabled) and active cipher suites. We included command outputs demonstrating enforcement on our gateway.

HSM attestation: vendor provided the PEM-style attestation (hsm_attestation_2024.pem) — attaching. Note that vendor attestation includes serial numbers and firmware versions. We should confirm if BlueHarbor requires on-site attestation copies or vendor-signed PDFs.

Attachments: [rotation_manifest_v1.pdf (pdf)], [hsm_attestation_2024.pem (pem)], [tls_cipher_list.txt (txt)]
